Facebook & Instagram Ad Management

Full-Funnel Campaign Architecture & Scaling

I build and manage your complete paid Meta funnel. Every ad dollar is strategically deployed to find high-intent buyers, decrease cost per purchase, and scale budget safely.

  • ABO & CBO Scaling Structures: Transition winning ad sets into Advantage+ campaign budgets with cost caps and bid limits.
  • Audience & Broad Targeting: Unlocking Meta's machine learning with broad, lookalike, and interest-based segmentation.
  • Dynamic Retargeting (DPA): Re-engaging website visitors and cart abandoners with dynamic catalog ads.
  • Daily Account Monitoring: Proactive bid adjustments, ad fatigue detection, and zero wasted ad spend.

Ad Creative Strategy & Copywriting

High-Converting Hooks, UGC & Angle Testing

In modern Facebook media buying, creative is your targeting. I research your audience's deepest pain points and design high-impact ad concepts that capture attention instantly.

  • 3-Second Hook Testing: Testing multiple visual and audio hooks to increase thumb-stop ratio and lower CPC.
  • UGC & Video Ad Frameworks: Structuring direct-response video scripts (Problem → Solution → Social Proof → CTA).
  • Direct-Response Copy: Writing compelling short and long-form ad copy that converts cold traffic into paying customers.
  • Static Ad Concepts: High-CTR graphic designs, split-screen comparisons, and PR feature banners.
Upgrade My Ad Creatives

Meta Pixel & CAPI Tracking Setup

Recover Lost iOS Data & Ensure Accurate Attribution

If your tracking is broken, Facebook's algorithm cannot find your ideal customers. I set up bulletproof server-side tracking so every sale and lead is accurately measured.

  • Meta Conversions API (CAPI): Server-to-server tracking bypassing ad-blockers and iOS privacy restrictions.
  • High Event Match Quality (EMQ): Passing hashed customer parameters (email, phone, city) for 8.0+ match scores.
  • Event Deduplication: Seamless sync between browser Pixel and server CAPI to eliminate double-counted purchases.
  • Custom Conversion Funnels: Tracking custom checkout flows, lead qualification steps, and high-value actions.
